author: Isaac Goffin
title: Man arrested after allegedly firing shots at Jefferson County deputies - NewsBreak
text:
By Isaac Goffin ,
10 hours ago
PINSON, Ala. ( WIAT ) — A man is in custody after he allegedly fired shots at Jefferson County deputies late Monday night.
According to the Jefferson County Sheriff’s Office, deputies responded around 11:22 p.m. Monday to the 4000 block of St. John Lane in Pinson to investigate a report of the man allegedly assaulting his girlfriend.
At the scene, deputies made contact Triston Wilhite, 39, who then allegedly fired shots at them. Deputies returned fired. Wilhite then fled on foot into the nearby woods.
The JCSO stated that more deputies responded and established a perimeter. Wilhite was found in the woods near the 4000 block of Leigh Lane around 1:36 a.m. Tuesday and was arrested.
Family dies in Birmingham house fire Wilhite has been charged with attempted murder, third-degree domestic violence (aggravated assault) and discharging a firearm into an occupied dwelling. He is in the Jefferson County Jail on $96,000 bond.
Center Point Fire District personnel conducted a welfare check on the female victim and her two children. No injuries were reported.
Those with information on the case are asked to call the JCSO at 205-325-1450 or submit an anonymous tip to Crime Stoppers at 205-254-7777.
